analyzed: kutas anukṛteḥ tam eva bhāntam anubhāti sarvam iti vākyaśeṣe sūrya ādīnām bhagavat kriyā anusāri prakāśa ākhya kriyā katarṛ tva śravaṇāt tasya bhāsā sarvam idam vibhāti iti jagataḥ paramātma prabhā prakāśya tva śruteḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: viṣṇureva "īśāno bhūtabhavyasya" iti īśānaśabdavācyatvena pramitaḥ | tattvato niścitaḥ | na tu vāyuḥ | kutaḥ ? śabdādeva "madhye vāmanam" iti nirakāśavāmanaśruterevetyarthaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: viṣṇuḥ eva īśānaḥ bhūta bhavyasya iti īśāna śabda vācyatvena pramitaḥ tattvataḥ niścitaḥ na tu vāyuḥ kutas śabdāt eva madhye vāmanam iti nirakāśa vāmana śruteḥ eva iti arthaḥ
om hṛdi apekṣayā tu manuṣya adhikāra tvāt om

original: tuśabda evārthe | apiśabdārthe ca | tathā ca sarvagatasyāpi viṣṇoḥ aṅguṣṭhamātratvoktiḥ hṛdyapekṣayā
analyzed: tuśabdaḥ eva arthe apiśabda arthe ca tathā ca sarva gatasya api viṣṇoḥ aṅguṣṭha mātra tva uktiḥ hṛdi apekṣayā

original: aṅguṣṭhaparimitahṛdyākāśāpekṣayaiva | na tāvatā viṣṇoḥ paricchinnatvaṃ jñeyamityarthaḥ | nanu paśvādīnāmaṅguṣṭhābhāvātkathaṃ tanmātratvavacanaṃ sarvādhikārikamityata uktam | manuṣyādhikāratvāditi | tathā caitadvidyopāsanasya manuṣyādhikārikatvāt | tānpratyetadvidyāpravṛttisambhavāt | paśvādīnāmaṅguṣṭhābhāve'pi na doṣa iti bhāvaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: aṅguṣṭha parimita hṛdi ākāśa apekṣayā eva na tāvatā viṣṇoḥ paricchinna tvam jñeyam iti arthaḥ nanu paśu ādīnām aṅguṣṭha abhāvāt katham tanmātra tva vacanam sarva ādhikārikam iti atas uktam manuṣya adhikāra tvāt iti tathā ca etad vidyā upāsanasya manuṣya ādhikārika tvāt tān prati etad vidyā pravṛtti sambhavāt paśu ādīnām aṅguṣṭha abhāve pi na doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

om tad upari api bādarāyaṇaḥ sambhavāt om

original: taduparyapi devatvayogyamanuṣyāṇāṃ na kevalaṃ manuṣyatvadaśāyāṃ kintu devāditvaprāptyanantaramapi vedavidyādhikāro'sti | kutaḥ? sambhavāt teṣāmapyadhikāraprayojakaviśiṣyabudhvayāderyogāditi bādarāyaṇo bhagavānvaktītyarthaḥ | 1 ||
analyzed: tad upari api deva tva yogya manuṣyāṇām na kevalam manuṣya tva daśāyām kintu deva ādi tva prāpti anantaram api veda vidyā adhikāraḥ usti kutas sambhavāt teṣām api adhikāra prayojaka viśiṣya budh vaya ādeḥ yogāt iti bādarāyaṇaḥ bhagavān vakti iti arthaḥ
om virodhaḥ karmaṇi iti ced nānaka pratipatteḥ darśanāt om

original: devādīnāṃ sāditve karmaṇi pūrvakalpe pravṛttayajñādikarmaṇi viṣaye | virodhaḥ uddeśyābhāvanimittavaiyarthyākhyavirodhaḥ | syāditicenna | kutaḥ anekapratipatteḥ anekeṣāṃ yogyamanuṣyāṇāṃ devatāpadaprāpterdarśanāt | "yatra pūrve" iti śrutāvuktatvādityarthaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: deva ādīnām sādi tve karmaṇi pūrva kalpe pravṛtta yajña ādi karmaṇi viṣaye virodhaḥ uddeśya abhāva nimitta vaiyarthya ākhya virodhaḥ syāt iti ced na kutas aneka pratipatteḥ anekeṣām yogya manuṣyāṇām devatā pada prāpteḥ darśanāt yatra pūrve iti śrutau ukta tvāt iti arthaḥ
om śabdaḥ iti ced na atas prabhāvāt pratyakṣa anumānābhyām om

original: virodha iti vartate | devānāmādyantavattve śabde vede apramāṇyākhyavirodhaḥ syānnityatvena śrutisiddhavedavācām | katācidvācyahīnatvāditi bhāva iti cenna | ataḥ "dhātā yathā" iti vedavākyāt | tathā pratyakṣānumānābhyām | mahatāṃ pratyakṣāt | devānāṃ pravāhataḥ utpattisādhakaliṅgācca | prabhavāt pratikalpam |
analyzed: virodhaḥ iti vartate devānām ādi antavat tve śabde vede apramāṇya ākhya virodhaḥ syāt nitya tvena śruti siddha veda vācām katā cit vācya hīna tvāt iti bhāvaḥ iti ced na atas dhātā yathā iti veda vākyāt tathā pratyakṣa anumānābhyām mahatām pratyakṣāt devānām pravāhataḥ utpatti sādhaka liṅgāt ca prabhavāt pratikalpam
niyamena prabhava śabdita utpatti avagamāt ca uktam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: oṃ ata eva ca nityatvam oṃ ||
analyzed: om atas eva ca nitya tvam om

original: ata eva pūvaryapakṣyuktavedanityatvādeva tadanyathā'nupapattyāpi tadvācyadevapravāhasya nityatvaṃ sidhyatītyarthaḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: atas eva pūvarya pakṣi ukta veda nitya tvāt eva tad anyathā anupapattyā api tad vācya deva pravāhasya nitya tvam sidhyati iti arthaḥ
om samāna nāma rūpa tvāt ca avṛttau api avirodhaḥ darśanāt smṛteḥ ca om

original: avṛttāvapi pūrvakalpe muktānāṃ devānāṃ punaḥ svapadeṣu avattve'pi | avirodhaḥ tatpratipādakaikavidhavedāprāmaraṇyākhyavirodho nāsti | kutaḥ? samānanāmarūpatvāt etatkalpotpannānāmapi devānāṃ prācīnatulyanāmarūpatvāt | tathā ca pratipādyasyāpyekavidhatvāt na tadbodhakavedāprāmāṇyamiti bhāvaḥ | ekavidhatvameva kuta ityata uktam | daśarnātsmṛteśceti |
analyzed: avṛttau api pūrva kalpe muktānām devānām punar sva padeṣu avattve pi avirodhaḥ tad pratipādaka ekavidha veda aprāmaraṇya ākhya virodhaḥ na asti kutas samāna nāmarūpa tvāt etad kalpa utpannānām api devānām prācīna tulya nāmarūpa tvāt tathā ca pratipādyasya api ekavidha tvāt na tad bodhaka veda aprāmāṇyam iti bhāvaḥ ekavidha tvam eva kutas iti atas uktam daśarnāt smṛteḥ ca iti
yathā pūrvam iti śruteḥ anādinidhanā iti smṛteḥ ca iti arthaḥ
om madhu ādiṣu asambhavāt anadhikāram jaiminiḥ om

original: madhvādiṣu "asau vā ādityo devamadhu" ityādyuktamadhvādividyāsu | anadhikāraṃ devānāmadhikārābhāvam | jaiminirācāryo manyate | kutaḥ? asambhavāt teṣāmarthitvatatpadayogyatvādyayogādityarthaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: madhu ādiṣu asau vai ādityaḥ deva madhu ityādi ukta madhu ādi vidyāsu anadhikāram devānām adhikāra abhāvam jaiminiḥ ācāryaḥ manyate kutas asambhavāt teṣām arthi tva tad pada yogya tva ādya yogāt iti arthaḥ
om jyotiṣi bhāvāt ca om

original: jyotiṣi devānāṃ jñāne bhāvāt sarvavastūnāṃ viṣayatayā'ntarbhūtatvāt | siddhajñānāṃ devānāṃ na jñānārthitā yujyata iti na mokṣavidyāsvapyadhikāra ityarthaḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: jyotiṣi devānām jñāne bhāvāt sarva vastūnām viṣaya tayā antarbhūta tvāt siddha jñānām devānām na jñāna arthi tā yujyate iti na mokṣa vidyāsu api adhikāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: oṃ bhāvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo'sti hi oṃ ||
analyzed: om bhāvam tu bādarāyaṇaḥ asti hi om

original: hi yasmāt | devānāmapyasti vidyāsādhyāpūrvaprakāśaviśeṣo mekṣaphale atiśayaścāsti | tasmādbhāvaṃ devānāmadhikārasadbhāvaṃ manyata ityarthaḥ | jaiminimataṃ tu devānāṃ prāptajñānaphalārthamanadhikārāmiprāyamityavadheyam || 8 |
analyzed: hi yasmāt devānām api asti vidyā sādhya apūrva prakāśa viśeṣaḥ mekṣa phale atiśayaḥ ca asti tasmāt bhāvam devānām adhikāra sadbhāvam manyate iti arthaḥ jaimini matam tu devānām prāpta jñāna phala artham anadhikāra amiprāyam iti avadheyam
apaśūdrā adhikaraṇam
om śuc asya tad anādara śravaṇāt tad ādravaṇāt sūcyate hi om

original: asya pautrāyaṇākhyasya rājñaḥ tadanādaraśravaṇāt haṃsakṛtasya "kambara enam" ityanādarasyaśravaṇaśannimittāt | śukśokaḥ | tathāpi kutaḥ śokaḥ? ityata uktam | sūcyate hīti | hi yasmāt | "sa ha sañjihāna eva" ityuttaravākyena sūcyate tathā jñāyate | tasmācchokaḥ asmādeva nimittāt | rājā raikkeṇa ṛṣiṇā śūdreti sambodhitaḥ |
analyzed: asya pautrāyaṇa ākhyasya rājñaḥ tad anādara śravaṇāt haṃsa kṛtasya kambaraḥ enam tathā api kutas śokaḥ iti atas uktam sūcyate hi iti hi yasmāt sa ha sañjihānaḥ eva iti uttara vākyena sūcyate tathā jñāyate tasmāt śokaḥ asmāt eva nimittāt rājā raikkeṇa ṛṣiṇā śūdra iti sambodhitaḥ

original: na tu varṇāvaratvābhiprāyeṇetyarthaḥ | tathā ca naitajjñāpakabalena śūdrasya vedavidyādhikāro mantavya iti bhāvaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: na tu varṇa avara tva abhiprāyeṇa iti arthaḥ tathā ca na etad jñāpaka balena śūdrasya veda vidyā adhikāraḥ mantavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ
om kṣatriya tva avagateḥ ca uttaratra caitrarathena liṅgāt om

original: caḥ liṅgāntarasamuccaye | uttaratra hi ityuttaravākye | śruteneti śeṣaḥ | caitrarathena
analyzed: caḥ liṅga antara samuccaye uttaratra hi iti uttara vākye śrutena iti śeṣaḥ caitrarathena

original: citraśabdādaśvatarīyuktarathasambandhitvarūpeṇa liṅgāt | liṅgena ca jñāpakena cāsya kṣatriyatvāvagateśca | kṣatriyatvajñānāt | na pautrāyaṇaḥ śūdra ityarthaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: citra śabdāt aśvatarī yukta ratha sambandhi tva rūpeṇa liṅgāt liṅgena ca jñāpakena ca asya kṣatriya tva avagateḥ ca kṣatriya tva jñānāt na pautrāyaṇaḥ śūdraḥ iti arthaḥ
om saṃskāra parāmarśa t tad abhāva abhilāpāt ca om

original: sādhyasamuccaye caśabdaḥ | saṃskāraparāmarśāt "aṣyavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamupanayīta tamadhyāpayīta" ityetacchabdena "nāgnirnayajñaḥ" iti saṃskārābhāvābhidhānāt | na tasya vedavidyādhikāra ityarthaḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: sādhya samuccaye caśabdaḥ saṃskāra parāmarśāt brāhmaṇam upanayīta tam adhyāpayīta iti etad śabdena na agniḥ na yajñaḥ iti saṃskāra abhāva abhidhānāt na tasya veda vidyā adhikāraḥ iti arthaḥ
om ca pravṛtteḥ

original: co'vadhāraṇe | tadabhāvanirdhāraṇe satyakāmākhyapuruṣasya śūdratvābhāvaniścaye satyeva | pravṛtte rgautamasya tadupanayane pravṛttatvāt | asmājjñāpakānna śūdrasya sāskāro yujyata ityarthaḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: tad abhāva nirdhāraṇe satyakāma ākhya puruṣasya śūdra tva abhāva niścaye sati eva pravṛtteḥ gautamasya tad upanayane pravṛtta tvāt asmāt jñāpakāt na śūdrasya sāskāraḥ yujyate iti arthaḥ
om śravaṇa adhyayana artha pratiṣedhāt smṛteḥ ca om

original: śravaṇādhyayanārthapratiṣedhāt śūdrasya vedaśravaṇatadadhyayanatadarthāvadhāraṇānāṃ "śravaṇe trapujatubhyāṃ śrotraparipūraṇam" iti pratiṣiddhatvāt | smṛteḥ nāgnirnayajñaḥ śūdrasyeti niṣedhakasmṛteśca na tasya vedavidyādhikāra ityarthaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: śravaṇa adhyayana artha pratiṣedhāt śūdrasya veda śravaṇa tad adhyayana tad artha avadhāraṇānām śravaṇe trapu jatubhyām śrotra paripūraṇam iti pratiṣiddha tvāt smṛteḥ na agniḥ na yajñaḥ śūdrasya iti niṣedhaka smṛteḥ ca na tasya veda vidyā adhikāraḥ iti arthaḥ
kampanā adhikaraṇam 10
om kampanāt om

original: "mahadbhayaṃ vajram" iti vajraśabdavācyā viṣṇureva nātvindrāyudham | kutaḥ? kakpanāt "sarvamejati" iti kampanaśabditasarvaceṣyakatvaliṅgaśravaṇādityarthaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: mahat bhayam vajram iti vajra śabda vācyāḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na atu indrāyudham kutas kakpanāt sarvam ejati iti kampana śabdita sarva ceṣyaka tva liṅga śravaṇāt iti arthaḥ
jyotiḥ adhikaraṇam 11
om jyotiḥ darśanāt om

original: "yo'yamantarjyotiḥ" iti jyotiśśabdavācyo viṣṇureva na jīvaḥ | kutaḥ? darśanāt "viṣṇureva jyotiḥ" (caturvedaśi) iti śruterityarthaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: yaḥ yam antar jyotiḥ iti jyotiḥ śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na jīvaḥ kutas darśanāt viṣṇuḥ eva jyotiḥ iti śruteḥ iti arthaḥ
ākāśa adhikaraṇam 12
om om

original: "ākāśo ha vai nāma" iti śrutyuktakāśo viṣṇureva | na tvavyākṛtākāśaḥ | kutaḥ? arthāntaratvādivyapadeśāt "te yadantarā" iti vākye viṣṇārnāmarūparāhityākhyavilakṣaṇārthatvasya ādiśabdagṛhītabrahmatvāmṛtatvayośca uktatvādityarthaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: ākāśaḥ ha vai nāma iti śruti ukta kāśaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na tu avyākṛta ākāśaḥ kutas artha antara tva ādi vyapadeśāt te yat antarā iti vākye viṣṇoḥ nāma rūpa rāhitya ākhya vilakṣaṇa arthatvasya ādi śabda gṛhīta brahma tva amṛta tvayoḥ ca ukta tvāt iti arthaḥ
suṣupti adhikaraṇam 13
om suṣupti utkrantyoḥ bhedena om

original: "sa yattatra kiñcitpaśyati" iti śrutyuktasvapnādidraṣyā paramātmaiva | na jīvaḥ | kutaḥ "asaṅgohyayaṃ puruṣaḥ" ityuktāsaṅgatvaliṅgāditi heturbahirevādhyāhāryaḥ | nanvīśvarābhedena jīvepyasaṅgatvoktiḥ sambhavatītyata uktam | suṣuptītyādi |
analyzed: sa yat tatra kiñcid paśyati iti śruti ukta svapna ādi draṣyā paramātmā eva na jīvaḥ kutas asaṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ iti ukta asaṅga tva liṅgāt iti hetuḥ bahis eva adhyāhāryaḥ nanu īśvara abhedena jīva ipi asaṅga tva uktiḥ sambhavati iti atas uktam suṣupti ityādi

original: tathā ca suṣuptyutkrantyāḥ "prājñenātmanā sampariṣvaktaḥ" iti "prājñenātmanā'nvārūḍhaḥ" iti ca suṣuptyutkrantiprakaraṇayoḥ | bhedena jīveśayorbhinnatvenokteḥ | na tayoraikyamityarthaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: tathā ca suṣupti utkrantyāḥ prājñena ātmanā sampariṣvaktaḥ iti prājñena ātmanā anvārūḍhaḥ iti ca suṣupti utkranti prakaraṇayoḥ bhedena jīva īśayoḥ bhinna tvena ukteḥ na tayoḥ aikyam iti arthaḥ
brāhmaṇa adhikaraṇam 14
om pati ādi śabdebhyaḥ om

original: eṣa nityo mahimā brāhmaṇasya" iti śrutyuktabrahmaṇo viṣṇureva | na viriñcaḥ | kutaḥ? patyādiśabdebhyaḥ sarvasyādhipatirityādirvādhipatyādivāci śrutibhyaḥ ityarthaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: eṣa nityaḥ mahimā brāhmaṇasya iti śruti ukta brahmaṇaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva na viriñcaḥ kutas pati ādi śabdebhyaḥ sarvasya adhipatiḥ iti ādiḥ vā adhipati ādi vāci śrutibhyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: iti śrījagannāthayatikṛtāyāṃ sūtradīpikāyāṃ prathamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || 1-3 ||
analyzed: iti śrī jagannātha yati kṛtāyām sūtradīpikāyām prathama adhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
ānumānika adhikaraṇam

original: oṃ ānumānikamapyekeṣāmiti cenna śarīrarūpakavinyastagṛhīterdarśayati ca oṃ ||
analyzed: om ānumānikam api ekeṣām iti ced na śarīra rūpaka vinyasta gṛhīteḥ darśayati ca om

original: apirevārthe | caḥ smṛtisamuccaye | tathā ca yataḥ ānumānikaṃ sāṃkhyānumānakalpitaṃ prādhānādyeva | ekeṣāṃ śākhināṃ śākhāsu
analyzed: apiḥ eva arthe caḥ smṛti samuccaye tathā ca yatas ānumānikam sāṃkhya anumāna kalpitam prādhāna ādi eva ekeṣām śākhinām śākhāsu

original: sthitai; "avyaktātpuruṣaḥ" ityādivākyagatāvyaktādiśabdairucyate | ato na viṣṇoḥ sarvaśabdavācyatvaṃ yujyata
analyzed: sthitaiḥ avyaktāt puruṣaḥ ityādi vākya gata avyakta ādi śabdaiḥ ucyate atas na viṣṇoḥ sarva śabda vācya tvam yujyata

original: iti cenna | yataḥ viṣṇurevāvyaktādiśabdavācyaḥ | na pradhānādiḥ | tatkutaḥ? yataḥ "avyaktam" (pippalādaśā) iti śrutiḥ "avyakto'kṣaṇaḥ" iti smṛtiśca | darśayati viṣṇorevāvyaktādiśabdavācyatvaṃ pratipādayati | ata ityatharḥ | kathaṃ tarhyanyatrāvyaktādiśabdavyavahāra ityata uktam | śarīrarūpaketyādi | kapratyayaḥ kutsane |
analyzed: iti ced na yatas viṣṇuḥ eva avyakta ādi śabda vācyaḥ na pradhāna ādiḥ tat kutas yatas avyaktam iti śrutiḥ avyakta ukṣaṇaḥ iti smṛtiḥ ca darśayati viṣṇoḥ eva avyakta ādi śabda vācya tvam pratipādayati atas iti atharḥ katham tarhi anyatra avyakta ādi śabda vyavahāraḥ iti atas uktam śarīra rūpaka ityādi kapratyayaḥ kutsane

original: tathā ca śarīrarūpakavinyastagṛhīte; | yathā śarīraṃ puruṣatantram | tathā paramātmatantratvena nimittena śarīrasame kutsitatvāt vastutaḥ aśarīre pradhānādau | vinyastasya sthitasya paramātmana evāvyaktādiśabdaiḥ gṛhīteḥ grahaṇāt | tathā ca paramātmasambandhādevānyatra prakṛtyādavavyaktādiśabdavācyatvavyavahāra ityarthaḥ || 1 ||

original: brahma ānandaguṇakaṃ tadrūpañca bhavati | kutaḥ ubhayavyapadeśāt ānando brahma ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ ityādiśrutiṣu guṇātmakatvena guṇitvena ca brahmaṇaḥ uktatvāt | tadapi katham | ahikuṇḍalavat yathā'heḥ sarpasya | kuṇḍalatvaṃ kuṇḍalitvañca | viśeṣāttathetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: brahma ānanda guṇakam tad rūpam ca bhavati kutas ubhaya vyapadeśāt ānandaḥ brahma ānandam brahmaṇaḥ ityādi śrutiṣu guṇa ātmaka tvena guṇi tvena ca brahmaṇaḥ ukta tvāt tat api katham ahi kuṇḍala vat yathā aheḥ sarpasya kuṇḍala tvam kuṇḍali tvam ca viśeṣāt tathā iti arthaḥ
om prakāśa āśrayavat vā tejaḥ tvāt om

original: yathā prakāśāśrayasyādityasya prakāśarūpatvaṃ tadāśrayatvañca tadvat brahmaṇo'pi | anyaparityāgenādityadṛṣyānte ko heturityata uktam | tejastvāditi | brahmādityayorubhayorapi tejorūpatvāt tadabhiprāyeṇa taddṛṣyāntīkaraṇamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yathā prakāśa āśrayasya ādityasya prakāśa rūpa tvam tad āśraya tvam ca tadvat brahmaṇaḥ api anya parityāgena āditya dṛṣya ante kaḥ hetuḥ iti atas uktam tejaḥ tvāt iti brahma ādityayoḥ ubhayoḥ api tejaḥ rūpa tvāt tad abhiprāyeṇa tad dṛṣya antīkaraṇam iti arthaḥ
om pūrvavat vā om

original: yathā kālaḥ pūrveṇābhinno'pi pūrvakāla iti pūrvapadena viśiṣyate tathā brahma ānandena viśiṣyata ityarthaḥ | ādarārthaṃ sthūralasūkṣmabuddhivivakṣayā vā dṛṣyāntatrayoktiḥ |
analyzed: yathā kālaḥ pūrveṇa abhinnaḥ api pūrva kālaḥ iti pūrva padena viśiṣyate tathā brahma ānandena viśiṣyate iti arthaḥ ādara artham sthūrala sūkṣma buddhi vivakṣayā vā dṛṣya anta traya uktiḥ
om pratiṣedhāt ca om

original: brahmaguṇānāṃ brahmaṇaśca "neha nānāsti" iti bhedasya | pratiṣedhācca brahma guṇātmakamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: brahma guṇānām brahmaṇaḥ ca na iha nānā asti iti bhedasya pratiṣedhāt ca brahma guṇa ātmakam iti arthaḥ
paramata adhikaraṇam
om paramatas setu unmāna sambandha bheda vyapadeśebhyaḥ om

original: brahmaguṇajātaṃ paraṃ lokavilakṣaṇam | kutaḥ setūnmānasambandhabhedavyapadeśebhyaḥ "eṣa sutuḥ" iti setutvokteḥ | "yato vācaḥ" ityunmānaśabditapūrṇatvokteḥ | "etasyaivānandasya" iti bimbapratibimbabhāvasambandhokteḥ | anyajjñānaṃtviti laukikānandādbhedokteścetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: brahma guṇa jātam param loka vilakṣaṇam kutas setu unmāna sambandha bheda vyapadeśebhyaḥ eṣa sutuḥ iti setu tva ukteḥ yatas vācaḥ iti unmāna śabdita pūrṇa tva ukteḥ etasya eva ānandasya iti bimba pratibimba bhāva sambandha ukteḥ anyat jñānam tu iti laukika ānandāt bheda ukteḥ ca iti arthaḥ
om darśanāt om
anya ānanda ādīnām pratyakṣa siddha tvāt manaḥ vāc viṣaya tvāt ca brahmānandasya atathātvāt eva loka vilakṣaṇa tvam iti arthaḥ
om buddhayarthaḥ pāda vat om

original: yathā lokapādavilakṣaṇeṣu jīvākhyabhūteṣu "pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni" iti pādapadaprayogaḥ | buddhayarthaḥ bhūtānāṃ īśāṃśattvajñāpanārthaḥ | tathā'laukike'pi brahmānandādāvānandapadaprayogaḥ | buddhayarthaḥ anukūlatayā vedanīyatvādidharmajñāpanārtha ityatharḥ |
analyzed: yathā loka pāda vilakṣaṇeṣu jīva ākhya bhūteṣu pādaḥ usya viśvā bhūtāni iti pāda pada prayogaḥ buddhayarthaḥ bhūtānām īśa aṃśa tva jñāpana arthaḥ tathā alaukike api brahmānanda ādau ānanda pada prayogaḥ buddhayarthaḥ anukūla tayā vedanīya tva ādi dharma jñāpana arthaḥ iti atharḥ
sthāna viśeṣa adhikaraṇam
om sthāna viśeṣāt prakāśa divat om
prakāśa ādi vat yathā sūryakānta ādi gata sūyara ādi pratibimba igni ja kanaka tva ādi vaicityam sthāna viśeṣāt
sūryakānta ādi sthāna guṇa vaicityāt upapadyate tathā brahma ādi sthāna gata bhakti ādi guṇa vaicityāt bhāgavat ānanda pratibimbeṣu brahma ādi āndeṣu api vaicityam upapadyate iti arthaḥ
om upapatteḥ ca om
bimba bhūta bhagavat aiśvarya vaśāt eva pratibimba bhūta brahma ādi ānanda vaicitya upapatteḥ ca tat pratibimbam itareṣām yuktam iti arthaḥ
tathā anya tva adhikaṇam
om tathā anya pratiṣedhāt om

original: yathā jīvānanadādi brahmanandādervilakṣaṇam | tathā dhyānakāle pratītaṃ vāsanātmakaṃ vastu | brahmaṇo'nyat tadbhinnam | kutaḥ "yanmanasā" iti śrutāvanyasya brahmatvapratiṣedhādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yathā jīvānanada ādi brahmananda ādeḥ vilakṣaṇam tathā dhyāna kāle pratītam vāsanā ātmakam vastu brahmaṇaḥ anyat tat bhinnam kutas yat manasā iti śrutau anyasya brahma tva pratiṣedhāt iti arthaḥ
sarvagata tva adhikaraṇam
om anena sarvagata tva māyā maya śabda ādibhyaḥ om

original: anena bhagavataiva | sarvadeśakālayoḥ sṛṣyayādirbhavati | na tu deśakālāntarayoranyena | kutaḥ sarvagatatvamāyāmayaśabdādibhyaḥ "eṣa sarvagata;" iti (bhāllaveya) sarvagatatvaśruteḥ | tasya ca sṛṣyayādyarthatvāt | viṣṇau prayuktamāyāmayaśabdavyākhyānarūpasarvatretyādi (catuvaredaśi) śruteścetyarthaḥ | anyatra pramāṇābhāvāccetyādiśabdārthaḥ |
analyzed: anena bhagavatā eva sarva deśa kālayoḥ sṛṣyayādiḥ bhavati na tu deśa kāla antarayoḥ anyena kutas sarvagata tva māyā maya śabda ādibhyaḥ eṣa sarva gataḥ iti bhāllaveya sarva gata tva śruteḥ tasya ca sṛṣyayādi artha tvāt viṣṇau prayukta māyā maya śabda vyākhyāna rūpa sarvatra ityādi śruteḥ ca iti arthaḥ anyatra pramāṇa abhāvāt ca ityādi śabda arthaḥ
phala adhikaraṇam
om phalamataḥ upapatteḥ om

original: phalaṃ svargādi | ataḥ īśvarādeva bhavati | na karmataḥ | kutaḥ upapatteḥ īśvarasya cetanatvena phaladātṛtvasya yuktatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: phalam svarga ādi atas īśvarāt eva bhavati na karmataḥ kutas upapatteḥ īśvarasya cetana tvena phala dātṛ tvasya yuktatvāt iti arthaḥ
om śruta tvāt ca om
śruta tvāt ca rātiḥ iti śruti ukta tvāt ca īśvarasya eva phala dātṛ tvam iti arthaḥ
om dharmam jaiminiḥ atas eva om

original: jaiminirācāryaḥ dharmaṃ phalapradamāha | taṃ ca dharmam | ata eva īśvarādeva janyaṃ manyate | kutaḥ ata eva "eṣa hyeva" iti śruterevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: jaiminiḥ ācāryaḥ dharmam phala pradam āha tam ca dharmam atas eva īśvarāt eva janyam manyate kutas atas eva eṣa hi eva iti śruteḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: oṃ pūrvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo hetuvyapadeśāt oṃ ||
analyzed: om pūrvam tu bādarāyaṇaḥ hetu vyapadeśāt om

original: bādarāyaṇācāryastu | pūrvaṃ pūrvoktam | brahma dharmaṃ cobhayaṃ phalahetuṃ manyate | tatra brahmakartṛtvena kamar karaṇatvena heturiti viśeṣastuśabdārthaḥ | kutaḥ hetuvyapadeśāt "puṇyena" iti śrutau brahmakarmaṇoḥ kartṛtvakaraṇatvarūpahetutvasyoktatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: bādarāyaṇa ācāryaḥ tu pūrvam pūrva uktam brahma dharmam ca ubhayam phala hetum manyate tatra brahma kartṛ tvena karaṇa tvena hetuḥ iti viśeṣaḥ tuśabda arthaḥ kutas hetu vyapadeśāt puṇyena iti śrutau brahma karmaṇoḥ kartṛ tva karaṇa tva rūpa hetu tvasya ukta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: iti śrījagannāthayatikṛtāyāṃ sūtradīpikāyāṃ tṛtīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || 3 || 2 ||
analyzed: iti śrī jagannātha yati kṛtāyām sūtradīpikāyām tṛtīya adhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ
sarva veda adhikaraṇam
om sarva vedānta pratyayam codana ādi aviśeṣāt om

original: pūrvasūtre pūrvapadoditaṃ brahma sarvavedāntapratyayam | bahuvrīhiḥ | yathāśakti sarvavedaviṣayakaśravaṇādyutpannanirṇayajanyajñānaviṣayam | kutaḥ codanādyaviśeṣāt "ātmā" ityādi vidhīnāmādipadoditānāṃ "atra hyate" ityādivākyoktayuktīnāṃ cāviśeṣāt | sarvādhikārisādhāraṇatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pūrva sūtre pūrva pada uditam brahma sarva vedānta pratyayam bahuvrīhiḥ yathāśakti sarva veda viṣayaka śravaṇa ādi utpanna nirṇaya janya jñāna viṣayam kutas codanā ādi aviśeṣāt ātmā ityādi vidhīnām ādi pada uditānām atra hyate ityādi vākya ukta yuktīnām ca aviśeṣāt sarva adhikāri sādhāraṇa tvāt iti arthaḥ
om bhedāt na iti ced ekasyām api om

original: cediti neti bhedāditi apīti cāvartate | tarhīti śākhāyāmiti ca labhyate | tathā ca cedyadi sarvaśākhoktārthānāṃ bhedāt pṛthatkvāt | ekekaina sarvaśākhoktaṃ jñeyaṃ na | kintu svasvāśākhoktamevetyucyate | tarhi api svasvaśākhoktamapi | na jñeyaṃ syāt | kutaḥ ekasyāṃ śākhāyāmapi bhedāt arthabhedadarśanāt |
analyzed: ced iti na iti bhedāt iti api iti ca āvartate tarhi iti śākhāyām iti ca labhyate tathā ca ced yadi sarva śākhā ukta arthānām bhedāt sarva śākhā uktam jñeyam na kintu sva sva śākhā uktam eva iti ucyate tarhi api sva sva śākhā uktam api na jñeyam syāt kutas ekasyām śākhāyām api bhedāt artha bheda darśanāt

original: atha yadi tatra dharmabhedādekasmin dharmiṇi bhinnadharmavidhānāt prasaṅgabhedācceti parihāra ucyate tasya sarvaśākhoktaparijñāne'pi sama ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atha yadi tatra dharma bhedāt ekasmin dharmiṇi bhinna dharma vidhānāt prasaṅga bhedāt ca iti parihāraḥ ucyate tasya sarva śākhā ukta parijñāne api samaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: oṃ svādhyāyasya tathātvena hi samācāre'dhikārācca oṃ ||
analyzed: om svādhyāyasya tathātvena hi samācāra adhikārāt ca om

original: svādhyāyasya "svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ" iti vidheḥ | tathātvena sarvasādhāraṇyenādhyayanavidhāyakatvena | samācāre sarvavaidikamarkaraṇe | adhikārāt sarveṣāmadhikārasadbhāvācca | hīti sūcitāyāḥ "vedaḥ kṛtsnodhikantavyaḥ" iti smṛteśca
analyzed: svādhyāyasya svādhyāyaḥ adhyetavyaḥ iti vidheḥ tathātvena sarva sādhāraṇyena adhyayana vidhāyaka tvena samācāre sarva vaidika markaraṇe adhikārāt sarveṣām adhikāra sadbhāvāt ca hi iti sūcitāyāḥ vedaḥ iti smṛteḥ ca
ekaikena api sarva śākhā adhyayanena brahma jñātavyam iti arthaḥ
om salila vat ca tad niyamaḥ om

original: co'vadhāraṇe | tanniyama ityatra pañcamītatpuṣakamardhārayau | salilavat salilamiva | tanniyamaḥ yathā sarveṣāṃ salilānāṃ pratibandhābhāvamapekṣyaiva samudraikāśrayatvaniyamaḥ | tathā'trāpi tasyāḥ puruṣaśaktimapekṣyaiva tanniyamaḥ | sarvavedoktaprakāreṇa dhyānena brahma jñātavyamiti niyama ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tad niyamaḥ iti atra salila vat salilam iva tad niyamaḥ yathā sarveṣām salilānām pratibandha abhāvam apekṣya eva samudra eka āśraya tva niyamaḥ tathā atra api tasyāḥ puruṣa śaktim apekṣya eva tad niyamaḥ sarva veda ukta prakāreṇa dhyānena brahma jñātavyam iti niyamaḥ iti arthaḥ
om upasaṃhāraḥ ṛtha abhedāt vidhi śeṣa vat samāne ca om

original: vidhiśeṣavat vidhivihitasyeva | yathā vidhivihitatvāt sandhyāvandanādikamavaśyaṃ kartavyam | tathā arthābhedāt bhedo vibhāgaḥ | sarvavedārthabhūtānāmānandādiguṇānāmapahatapāpmatvādidoṣābhāvānāṃ cābhedāt avibhāgāt | tānavibhajyati yāvat | upasaṃhāraḥ sarvaguṇānāmapyekabudhyārohaṇarūpopasaṃhāraḥ |
analyzed: vidhi śeṣa vat vidhi vihitasya iva yathā vidhi vihita tvāt sandhyā vandana ādikam avaśyam kartavyam tathā artha abhedāt bhedaḥ vibhāgaḥ sarva veda artha bhūtānām ānanda ādi guṇānām apahata pāpma tva ādi doṣa abhāvānām ca abhedāt avibhāgāt tān avibhajyati yāvat upasaṃhāraḥ sarva guṇānām api eka budhyā ārohaṇa rūpa upasaṃhāraḥ

original: "upāsya ekaḥ" iti (bhāllaveya) śrutau vihitatvāt kartavyaḥ | so'pi samāne ca samānaviṣaya eva | ye brahmaṇi yogyāḥ pūrṇatvāvirodhino guṇāḥ | tadviṣaya eva | natvayogyarodanādau | tathā satyanarthaprāpterityarthaḥ |
analyzed: upāsyaḥ ekaḥ iti bhāllaveya śrutau vihita tvāt kartavyaḥ saḥ api samāne ca samāna viṣaye eva ye brahmaṇi yogyāḥ pūrṇa tva avirodhinaḥ guṇāḥ tad viṣaye eva na tu ayogya rodana ādau tathā sati anartha prāpteḥ iti arthaḥ
om anyathātvam caśabdāt iti ced na aviśeṣāt om

original: anyathātvaṃ sarvaguṇopasaṃhāraḥ kārya ityuktasyānyathābhāvaḥ | tasyākartavyatvamevāvaśyamaṅgīkāryam | kutaḥ śabdāt "ātmetyevopāsīta" ityanupasaṃhāra śruteḥ iti cenna | aviśeṣāt ete guṇā nopasaṃhāyarāiti viśeṣapramāṇābhāvāt | sarvaiguṇairityaviśeṣeṇopasaṃhāre tu viśeṣapramāṇasadbhāvāccetyarthaḥ | ātmetyevetyevakārastvayogavyavacchedaka iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: anyathātvam sarva guṇa upasaṃhāraḥ kāryaḥ iti uktasya anyathābhāvaḥ tasya akartavya tvam eva avaśyam aṅgīkāryam kutas śabdāt ātmā iti eva upāsīta iti anupasaṃhāra śruteḥ iti ced na aviśeṣāt ete guṇāḥ viśeṣa pramāṇa abhāvāt sarvaiḥ guṇaiḥ iti aviśeṣeṇa upasaṃhāre tu viśeṣa pramāṇa sadbhāvāt ca iti arthaḥ ātmā iti eva iti eva kāraḥ tu ayoga vyavacchedakaḥ iti bhāvaḥ
om na vā prakaraṇa bhedāt parovīyaḥ tva ādi vat om

original: parovarīyastvādivat "yathā sa eṣaḥ" ityuktānāṃ niravadhikasarvottamatvarūpaparovarīyastvādigurānāmevopāsanārthamupasaṃho na sarvaguṇānām | tadvatsarvaguṇopasaṃhāro na kartavyo vā | kutaḥ prakaraṇebhedāt parorīyo vaiśvānarādiprakaraṇabhedāt | anyathā tanna syādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: parovarīyaḥ tva ādi vat yathā saḥ eṣaḥ iti uktānām niravadhika sarva uttama tva rūpa parovarīyaḥ tva ādi gurānām eva upāsana artham upasaṃhaḥ na sarva guṇānām tadvat sarva guṇa upasaṃhāraḥ na kartavyaḥ vā kutas prakaraṇa ibhedāt vaiśvānara ādi prakaraṇa bhedāt anyathā tat na syāt iti arthaḥ
om saṃjñātaḥ ced tat uktam asti tu tat api om

original: saṃjñātaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ bhagavannāmatvena tadguṇoktirūpatvāt | sarvavidyoktaguṇopasaṃhāraḥ kārya iti cet | taduktaṃ tatra codye tadiṣyameveti sāmādhānaṃ tenopasaṃhārasūtreṇoktamityarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ yuktisiddhametat | kintu tadapi tasminnarthe "nāma vā etā" iti (kauṇḍinyaśruteḥ) pramāṇamapyasti | tu asyevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: saṃjñātaḥ sarva vidyānām bhagavat nāma tvena tad guṇa ukti rūpatvāt sarvavidya ukta guṇa upasaṃhāraḥ kāryaḥ iti ced tat uktam tatra codye tat iṣyam eva iti sāmādhānam tena upasaṃhāra sūtreṇa uktam iti arthaḥ na kevalam yukti siddham etat kintu tat api tasmin arthe nāma vai etāḥ iti kauṇḍinya śruteḥ pramāṇam api asti tu asya iva iti arthaḥ
prāpti adhikaraṇam
om prāpteḥ ca samañjasam om

original: upasaṃhārānupasaṃhārayoḥ kartavyatvam | samañjasaṃ yuktam | kutaḥ prāpteḥ tattadyogyapuruṣabhedena tayoḥ vyavasthitatvādavirodhaprāpteścetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: upasaṃhāra anupasaṃhārayoḥ kartavya tvam samañjasam yuktam kutas prāpteḥ tad tad yogya puruṣa bhedena tayoḥ vyavasthita tvāt avirodha prāpteḥ ca iti arthaḥ
sarva abheda adhikaraṇam
om sarva abhedāt anyatra ime om

original: ime sarvaguṇopasaṃhartṛbrahmādayaḥ | anyatra tadanupasaṃhartṛbhyo'nyatra | tatphalavilakṣaṇamahāphale bhavanti tadbhājo bhavanti | kutaḥ sarvābhedāt sarvavedoktaguṇānāṃ avibhāgenopasaṃhartṛtvenopāsanādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: ime sarva guṇa upasaṃhartṛ brahma ādayaḥ anyatra tad anupasaṃhartṛbhyaḥ nyatra tad phala vilakṣaṇa mahā phale bhavanti tad bhājaḥ bhavanti kutas sarva abhedāt sarva veda ukta guṇānām avibhāgena upasaṃhartṛ tvena upāsanāt iti arthaḥ
ānanda adhikaraṇam
om ānanda ādayaḥ pradhānasya om

original: ānandādayaḥ ānando jñānaṃ sacchabdoditaṃ nirdoṣatvaṃ ātmapadoditasvāmitvamityete catvāro guṇāḥ | pradhānasya mokṣasyārthe sarvamumukṣubhi; upāsyā ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: ānanda ādayaḥ ānandaḥ jñānam sat śabda uditam nirdoṣa tvam ātma pada udita svāmi tvam iti ete catvāraḥ guṇāḥ pradhānasya mokṣasya arthe sarva mumukṣubhi upāsyāḥ iti arthaḥ
priyaśiraḥ tva adhikaraṇam
om priya śiraḥ tva ādi aprāptiḥ upacaya apacayau hi bhede om

original: sarveṣāmadhikāriṇāṃ priyaśirastvādyaprāptiḥ | "tasya priyameva śiraḥ" ityādiśrutyuktapriyaśirastvādiguṇopāsanayogyatā nāsti | kintu keṣāñcideva | kutaḥ hi yasmāt | teṣāṃ bhede phalabhede
analyzed: sarveṣām adhikāriṇām priya śiraḥ tva ādi aprāptiḥ tasya priyam eva śiraḥ ityādi śruti ukta priya śiraḥ tva ādi guṇa upāsana yogyatā na asti kintu keṣāñcid eva kutas hi yasmāt teṣām bhede phala bhede

original: phalatāratamye hi prasiddhā naiva sarveti (vārāha) smṛtirasti | yasmācca bhede phalabhedasiddhayarthaṃ upacayāpacayau upāsane vṛddhihrāsau | tāratamyamiti yāvat | apekṣitau tasmādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: phala tāratamye hi prasiddhā nā eva sarvā iti vārāha smṛtiḥ asti yasmāt ca bhede phala bheda siddhayartham upacaya apacayau upāsane vṛddhi hrāsau tāratamyam iti yāvat apekṣitau tasmāt iti arthaḥ
itara adhikaraṇam
om om

original: tuśabda evārthe | arthasāmānyāt | lyablopanimittā pañcamī | upāsanasya svasvaprāpyaphalasāmyamapekṣya itare caturthyaḥ sarvebhyaścetare madhyamā guṇāḥ devādibhirupasaṃhartavyā evetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tuśabdaḥ eva arthe artha sāmānyāt lyap lopa nimittā pañcamī upāsanasya sva sva prāpya phala sāmyam apekṣya itare caturthyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ ca itare madhyamāḥ guṇāḥ deva ādibhiḥ upasaṃhartavyāḥ eva iti arthaḥ
ādhyāna adhikaraṇam
om ādhyānāya prayojana abhāvāt om

original: vedeṣu savarguṇoktirupasaṃhāraśca ādhyānāya samyagjñānādhyānārtham | klṛpto bhavet | kutaḥ prayojanābhāvāt guṇoktestadupasaṃhārasya ca dhyānaṃ vinā prayojanābhāvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: vedeṣu savarguṇa uktiḥ upasaṃhāraḥ ca ādhyānāya samyak jñāna ādhyāna artham klṛptaḥ bhavet kutas prayojana abhāvāt guṇa ukteḥ tad upasaṃhārasya ca dhyānam vinā prayojana abhāvāt iti arthaḥ
om ātma śabdāt ca om

original: "ātmetyevopāsīta" ityatrātmeti bhāvapradhānaṃ sāvadhāṇañca | ātmatvamātropāstividhāyakaḥ śabda ātmaśabdaḥ | ātmetyevopāsīteti śabdaḥ | tasmādguṇāntaravyāvṛttipūrvamātmatvopāstividhāyakaśabdādanupasaṃhāraśca sidhyatīti cārthaḥ |
analyzed: ātmā iti eva upāsīta iti atra ātmā iti bhāva pradhānam sāvadhāṇam ca ātmatva mātra upāsti vidhāyakaḥ śabdaḥ ātma śabdaḥ ātmā iti eva upāsīta iti śabdaḥ tasmāt guṇa antara vyāvṛtti pūrvam ātmatva upāsti vidhāyaka śabdāt anupasaṃhāraḥ ca sidhyati iti ca arthaḥ
ātma gṛhīti adhikaraṇam
om ātma gṛhītiḥ itaravat uttarāt om

original: yataḥ itaravat "satyaṃ jñānam" ityādi vākye satyādipadairanyeṣāṃ guṇānāmivātmagṛhītiḥ ātmaiveti vākye'pyātmaśabdena catuṇarāṃ guṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ sambhavati | kutaḥ uttarāt "atrahyete" ityuttaravākyācca | ato na caturguṇopāstyuktestadvirodha ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yatas itara vat satyam jñānam ityādi vākye satya ādi padaiḥ anyeṣām guṇānām iva ātma gṛhītiḥ ātmā eva iti vākye pi ātma śabdena catuṇarām guṇānām grahaṇam sambhavati kutas uttarāt atra hi ete iti uttara vākyāt ca atas na caturguṇa upāsti ukteḥ tad virodhaḥ iti arthaḥ
anvaya adhikaraṇam
om anvayāt iti ced syāt avadhāraṇāt om

original: nanvātmeti vākyasyānupasaṃhāramānatvamayuktam | kutaḥ anvayāt ātmaśabde sarvaguṇānāmanvayāt | tasya tadbodhakatvāditi yāvat | iti cet syāt yatpārektaṃ tattathā syādeva | tathāpi nānupapattiḥ | kutaḥ avadhāraṇāt | ātmetyevetyavadhāraṇāt | na cānirṇayaḥ | ātmaśabdo hi brahmādīn pratyeva sarvaguṇānvadati nānyānpratīti nirṇayopapatterityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ātmā iti vākyasya anupasaṃhāra mānatvam ayuktam kutas anvayāt ātma śabde sarva guṇānām anvayāt tasya tad bodhaka tvāt iti yāvat iti ced syāt yat pārektam tat tathā syāt eva tathā api na anupapattiḥ kutas avadhāraṇāt ātmā iti eva iti avadhāraṇāt na ca anirṇayaḥ ātma śabdaḥ hi brahma ādīn prati eva sarva guṇān vadati na anyān prati iti nirṇaya upapatteḥ iti arthaḥ
kārya adhikaraṇam
om kārya ākhyānāt apūrvam om

original: kāryākhyānāt dhyānakāyarsya mokṣasyālaukikatvokteḥ | apūrvaṃ alaukikaṃ guṇajātam | dhyātavyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: kārya ākhyānāt mokṣasya alaukika tva ukteḥ apūrvam alaukikam guṇa jātam dhyātavyam iti arthaḥ
samāna adhikaraṇam
om samānaḥ evam ca abhedāt om

original: evañca evamapi | brahmaguṇānāmalaukikatve'pi | vāṇyāḥ samāne yogyaguṇaviṣaya evopasaṃhāraḥ natvayogyakriyāsu | tatratvabhedāt abhedamapekṣya trivikramatvādīnāṃ kādācitkānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ tatsajātīyanityavikrāntyādiṣvantarbhāvyopasaṃhāro bhavedityarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca evam api brahma guṇānām alaukika tve pi vāṇyāḥ samāne yogya guṇa viṣaye eva upasaṃhāraḥ na tu ayogya kriyāsu tatra tu abhedāt abhedam apekṣya trivikrama tva ādīnām kādācitkānām kriyāṇām tad sajātīya nitya vikrānti ādiṣu antar bhāvya upasaṃhāraḥ bhavet iti arthaḥ
om sambandhāt evam anyatra api om

original: hiraṇyagarbhasya tu anyatrāpi trivikramatvādikriyāviśeṣe'pi | evaṃ sarvadopasaṃhāro yujyate | kutaḥ sambandhāt kriyāṇāṃ brahmaṇā tādātmyarūpasambandhena nityatvādityatharḥ | ||
analyzed: hiraṇyagarbhasya tu anyatra api trivikrama tva ādi kriyā viśeṣe pi evam sarvadā upasaṃhāraḥ yujyate kutas sambandhāt kriyāṇām brahmaṇā tādātmya rūpa sambandhena nitya tvāt iti atharḥ
nava adhikaraṇam
om na vā viśeṣāt om

original: ātmeti vākyasthātmaśabdena sarvaguṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ navā'bhyupagamyate | kutaḥ viśeṣāt adhikāriyogyatāviśeṣamapekṣya tasya tadyogyaguṇābhidhāyakatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: ātmā iti vākya stha ātma śabdena sarva guṇānām grahaṇam na vā abhyupagamyate kutas viśeṣāt adhikāri yogyatā viśeṣam apekṣya tasya tad yogya guṇa abhidhāyaka tvāt iti arthaḥ
om darśayati ca om
sarvān iti bhāllaveya śrutiḥ sva ukta artham pratipādayati iti arthaḥ
sambhṛti adhikaraṇam
om ca atas om

original: ādipadena nañaḥ samākarṣaḥ | caśabda evārthaḥ | sambhṛtidyuvyāptī samyagbharaṇaprakāśavyāptī | na sarvasyopāsye | kintu devādyupāsye eva | kutaḥ ata evādhikāriyogyatāyāṃ viśeṣasadbhāvādevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: ādi padena nañaḥ samākarṣaḥ caśabdaḥ eva arthaḥ sambhṛti dyu vyāptī samyak bharaṇa prakāśa vyāptī na sarvasya upāsye kintu deva ādi upāsye eva kutas atas eva adhikāri yogyatāyām viśeṣa sadbhāvāt eva iti arthaḥ
puruṣa adhikaraṇam
om puruṣa vidyāyām api ca itareṣām anāmnānāt om

original: puruṣavidyāyāmapi sarvavidyottamatvena pratijñātāyāmapi | puruṣasūktākhyavidyāyāṃ keṣāñcidevoktatvāditareṣāṃ tatroktebhyo'nyeṣāñca guṇānāmanāmnānāt | kartavya eva sarvavidyāguṇopasaṃhāra ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: puruṣa vidyāyām api sarva vidyā uttama tvena pratijñātāyām api puruṣasūkta ākhya vidyāyām keṣāñcid eva ukta tvāt itareṣām tatra uktebhyaḥ nyeṣām ca guṇānām anāmnānāt kartavyaḥ eva sarva vidyā guṇa upasaṃhāraḥ iti arthaḥ
vedha adhikaraṇam
om vedha ādi artha bhedāt om

original: arthabhedāt vedhādyupāsanaphalasya hiṃsāderyatyādiyogyaphalādvilakṣaṇatvāt vedhādi bhindhi viddhi śṛṇīhī (bṛhattantre) tyuktavedhādikaṃ na sarvopāsyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: artha bhedāt vedha ādi upāsana phalasya hiṃsā ādeḥ yati ādi yogya phalāt vilakṣaṇa tvāt vedha ādi bhindhi viddhi śṛṇīhi bṛhattantre ti ukta vedha ādikam na sarva upāsyam iti arthaḥ
hāni adhikaraṇam
om hānau tu upāyana śabda śeṣa tvāt kuśācchanda stuti upagāna vat tat uktam om

original: turavadhāraṇe | yataḥ hānau bandhahānirūpamuktau | taduktaṃ muktānāṃ "etatsāma" iti śrutāvupāsanamuktam | ato mokṣe'pi teṣāmupāsanamatsyeva | tadapi kuśācchandastutyupagānavadeva na vidhitaḥ | yathā niyatabrahmayajñānāṃ dvijānāṃ niyatasandhyopāsanānantaramapi kuśairācchandena svecchayaiva stutyupagāna ivobhayatra nāmnoradhyayanam |
analyzed: tuḥ avadhāraṇe yatas hānau bandha hāni rūpa muktau tat uktam muktānām etat sāmaḥ iti śrutau upāsanam uktam atas mokṣe pi teṣām upāsanam atsi eva tat api kuśācchanda stuti upagāna vat eva na vidhitaḥ yathā niyata brahmayajñānām dvijānām niyata sandhyā upāsana anantaram api kuśaiḥ ācchandena sva icchayā eva stuti upagāne iva ubhayatra nāmnoḥ adhyayanam

original: tathā svecchayaiva na vidhitaḥ | kutaḥ upāyanaśabdaśeṣatvāt | upāyanaṃ mokṣaḥ upāsanāvidhīnāṃ mokṣavākyaśeṣatvādityarthaḥ | tathā ca mokṣārthā upāsanāvidhayaḥ kathaṃ tatrāpi tā vidadhyurityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tathā sva icchayā eva na vidhitaḥ kutas upāyana śabda śeṣa tvāt upāyanam mokṣaḥ upāsanā vidhīnām mokṣa vākya śeṣa tvāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca mokṣa arthāḥ upāsanā vidhayaḥ katham tatra api tāḥ vidadhyuḥ iti arthaḥ
om sāmparāye tartavya abhāvāt tathā hi anye om

original: sāmparāye mokṣe | upāsanaṃ svecchayaivetyaṅgīkāyarm | na tvaniṣyanivṛttyartham | kutaḥ tartavyābhāvāt muktaiḥ parihartavyāniṣyasyaivābhāvāt | tadapi kutaḥ hi yasmāt | anye śākhinaḥ tathā "tīrṇo hi" śrutiṃ paṭhanti | tasmādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: sāmparāye mokṣe upāsanam sva icchayā eva iti aṅgīkāyarm na tu aniṣya nivṛtti artham kutas tartavya abhāvāt muktaiḥ parihartavya aniṣyasya eva abhāvāt tat api kutas hi yasmāt anye śākhinaḥ tathā tīrṇaḥ hi śrutim paṭhanti tasmāt iti arthaḥ
chanda adhikaraṇam
chandataḥ ubhaya avirodhāt om

original: muktāḥ chandataḥ svecchāmanusṛtyaiva karma kurvanti na vidhitaḥ | kutaḥ ubhayāvirodhāt karmakaraṇākaraṇayoḥ vidhibandhapratyavāyayoḥ abhāvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: muktāḥ chandataḥ sva icchām anusṛtya eva karma kurvanti na vidhitaḥ kutas ubhaya avirodhāt karma karaṇa akaraṇayoḥ vidhi bandha pratyavāyayoḥ abhāvāt iti arthaḥ
om gateḥ atharva tvam ubhayathā anyathā hi virodhaḥ om

original: hirhetau | ubhayathā hi bandhapratyavāyayorabhāvādeva | gateḥ mukteḥ | puruṣārthatvam | anyathā muktau bandhapratyavāyayorbhāve | virodhaḥ mukte; saṃsārasamatvenāpuruṣārthatvarūpavirodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: hiḥ hetau ubhayathā hi bandha pratyavāyayoḥ abhāvāt eva gateḥ mukteḥ puruṣa artha tvam anyathā muktau bandha pratyavāyayoḥ bhāve virodhaḥ mukte saṃsāra samatvena a puruṣa artha tva rūpa virodhaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ
om upapannaḥ tad lakṣaṇa artha upalabdheḥ loka vat om

original: yathā loke yāgāṅgaviṣṇukramaṇasya kriyānuṣṭhānaniyamaḥ na yāgasampūtyarnantaramapi asti | kintu kadācideva | tathā muktānāṃ kadācitkarma kurvanti na vetyevaṃ tāvadupapannaḥ yuktaḥ | kuta etat | tallakṣaṇārthopalabdheḥ tallakṣaṇasya paramparayā karmasādhyasyātharsya mokṣasya | upalabdheḥ prāptatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yathā loke yāga aṅga viṣṇukramaṇasya kriyā anuṣṭhāna niyamaḥ na asti kintu kadācid eva tathā muktānām kadācid karma kurvanti na vā iti evam tāvat upapannaḥ yuktaḥ kutas etat tad lakṣaṇa artha upalabdheḥ tad lakṣaṇasya paramparayā karma sādhyasya atharsya mokṣasya upalabdheḥ prāptatvāt iti arthaḥ
aniyama adhikaraṇam
om aniyamaḥ sarveṣām avirodhāt śabda anumānābhyām om

original: aniyamaḥ aparokṣajñānināṃ madhye keṣāñcinmokṣaḥ keṣāñcinnetyevaṃrūpavyavasthābhāvo jñāyate | kutaḥ sarveṣāmapi mokṣe | avirodhāt niṣedhakābhāvāt | kiñca śabdānumānābhyāṃ "na kaścit" iti (kauṇḍinya) śruteḥ tanmūlakānumānaccetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: aniyamaḥ aparokṣa jñāninām madhye keṣāñcid mokṣaḥ keṣāñcid na iti evaṃrūpa vyavasthā bhāvaḥ jñāyate kutas sarveṣām api mokṣe avirodhāt niṣedhaka abhāvāt kiñca śabda anumānābhyām na kaścid iti kauṇḍinya śruteḥ
yāvadadhikaraṇam
om yāvadadhikāram avasthitiḥ ādhikārikāṇām om

original: ādhikārikāṇāṃ yogyatānusāryupāsanaśīlānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ svasvādhikārānusāreṇaiva muktau | avasthitiḥ | avasthitānāmupāsanāvattāratamyenaiva muktau teṣāṃ phalamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: ādhikārikāṇām yogyatā anusāri upāsana śīlānām brahma ādīnām sva sva adhikāra anusāreṇa eva muktau avasthitiḥ avasthitānām upāsanā vat tāratamyena eva muktau teṣām phalam iti arthaḥ
om akṣara dhiyām tu avirodhaḥ sāmānya tad bhāvābhyām aupasada vat tat uktam om

original: tuśabdo'pyarthaḥ | akṣaradhiyāṃ brahmajñāninām |kivaṣamatvepyavirodhaḥ virodho nāsti | kutaḥ brahmadhītvāt | kiñca sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāṃ sarveṣāṃ doṣābhāvāt uttamebhyaḥ adhamānāṃ upakārabhāvācca | katham | aupasadavat sacchiṣyavat | kiñca taduktaṃ tat asamatve'pi virodho nāstītyetat "nānā" iti turaśrutāvuktamato'pyavirodha ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tuśabdaḥ upi arthaḥ akṣara dhiyām brahma jñāninām virodhaḥ na asti kutas brahma dhī tvāt kiñca sāmānya tad bhāvābhyām sarveṣām doṣa abhāvāt uttamebhyaḥ adhamānām upakāra bhāvāt ca katham aupasada vat sat śiṣya vat kiñca tat uktam tat asama tve pi virodhaḥ na asti iti etat nānā iti turaśrutau uktam atas upi avirodhaḥ iti arthaḥ
iyat āmanana adhikaraṇam
om iyat āmananāt om
adhikāri tāratamyam iyat eva prāṇau adhikam eva kutas āmananāt
prāṇaḥ vāva iti kauṇṭharavya śruteḥ iti arthaḥ
om antarā bhūta grāma vat iti ced tat uktam om

original: bhūtagrāmavat yathā nāmādiprāṇasamūhe ekasmādeka uttamo dṛṣyaḥ | tathā antarā paramātmānaṃ śriyañca vinā prāṇādapyuttamrostviti cet | neti śeṣaḥ | yatastaduktaṃ tatra prāṇāduttamābhāve nahīti (kauṇṭharavya) pramāṇamuktam | ata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: bhūta grāma vat yathā nāma ādi prāṇa samūhe ekasmāt ekaḥ uttamaḥ dṛṣyaḥ tathā antarā paramātmānam śriyam ca vinā prāṇāt api uttamroḥ tu iti ced na iti śeṣaḥ yatas tat uktam tatra prāṇāt uttama abhāve nahi iti kauṇṭharavya pramāṇam uktam atas iti arthaḥ
om anyathā bheda anupapattiḥ iti ced na upadeśa vat om

original: anyathā prāṇādapyuttamābhāve | prāṇaparamātmano; bhedānupapattiriti cenna | kutaḥ yataḥ upadeśavat yathā śrutāvuktaṃ tathā'ṅgīkriyate | ato noktadoṣa ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: anyathā prāṇāt api uttama abhāve prāṇa paramātmanaḥ bheda anupapattiḥ iti ced na kutas yatas upadeśa vat yathā śrutau uktam tathā aṅgīkriyate atas na ukta doṣaḥ iti arthaḥ
vyatihāra adhikaraṇam
om vyatihāraḥ viśiṃṣanti hi itara vat om

original: vyatihāraḥ prāṇaprakaraṇādanantaraṃ viṣṇoḥ prakaraṇāt prāk praśnapraticvacanayoradhyāhāraḥ kārya; | kutaḥ hi yasmāt | iravat nāmādito vāgādikamiva prāravādinaḥ sakāśāt satyākhyaviṣṇuvādinaḥ chandogāḥ "eṣa tu vā" iti tuśabdena viśiṃṣanti vyāvartayanti | tasmādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: vyatihāraḥ prāṇa prakaraṇāt anantaram viṣṇoḥ prakaraṇāt prāk praśna praticvacanayoḥ adhyāhāraḥ kārya kutas hi yasmāt iravat nāma āditas vāc ādikam iva prāra vādinaḥ sakāśāt satya ākhya viṣṇu vādinaḥ chandogāḥ eṣa tu vā iti tuśabdena viśiṃṣanti vyāvartayanti tasmāt iti arthaḥ
satya adhikaraṇam
om sā eva hi satya ādayaḥ om

original: hi yasmāt | satyādyāḥ ahamātmāntaḥ padārthāḥ | saiva īśvarākhyaparadevataiva | tasmātprāṇādhikāḥ bahavaḥ na | kintu śrītadhīśāvevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: hi yasmāt satya ādyāḥ aham ātma antar padārthāḥ sā eva īśvara ākhya para devatā eva tasmāt prāṇa adhikāḥ bahavaḥ na kintu śrī tadhīśau eva iti arthaḥ
kāma adhikaraṇam
om kāmāt itaratra tatra ca āyatana ādibhyaḥ om

original: lakṣmīḥ tatra bhagavatsamīpe sthitā satī | itaratra ca bhūmyādāvapi | kāmāt īśvarecchayaivāvatārānkaroti | kutaḥ āyatanādibhyaḥ sarvagatatvapratipādakasarvāyatanetyādiśrutyādibhya ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: lakṣmīḥ tatra bhagavat samīpe sthitā satī itaratra ca bhūmi ādau api kāmāt īśvara icchayā eva avatārān karoti kutas āyatana ādibhyaḥ sarvagata tva pratipādaka sarva āyatana ityādi śruti ādibhyaḥ iti arthaḥ
om om

original: ādarāt bhagavati nirupādhikabhaktyatiśayāt | alopaḥ śriyo bhagavadupāsanābhāvo netyarthaḥ |
analyzed: ādarāt bhagavati nirupādhika bhakti atiśayāt alopaḥ śriyaḥ bhagavat upāsana abhāvaḥ na iti arthaḥ
om upasthiteḥ tad vacanāt om

original: śriyo nityamuktatvaṃ yujyate | kutaḥ upasthiteḥ harisamīpe sadā sthiteḥ | śriyo nityasamīpasthatvaṃ ca | tadvacanāt "dvāvetau" iti (gaupavanaśruteḥ" nityasambandhitvavacanāt | jñāyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: śriyaḥ nitya mukta tvam yujyate kutas upasthiteḥ hari samīpe sadā sthiteḥ śriyaḥ nitya samīpa stha tvam ca tad vacanāt dvau etau iti gaupavana śruteḥ nitya sambandhi tva vacanāt jñāyate iti arthaḥ
nirdhāraṇa adhikaraṇam
om phalam om

original: yatastannirdhāraṇārthaniyamaḥ vedārthaniścayo vedārthaniyamaścetyetadrūpam | śravaṇamananaphalam | dhyāphalabhūtāyāḥ | taddṛṣyeḥ brahmadaśarnāt | pṛthagevabhinnameva | ato na brahmadṛṣyiḥ śravaṇādinā bhavatītyarthaḥ | tathāpi na śravaṇamananavaiyarthyam | kutaḥ hi yasmāt | apratibandhaḥ brahmadṛṣyipratibandhakanivṛttiḥ |
analyzed: yatas tad nirdhāraṇa artha niyamaḥ veda artha niścayaḥ veda artha niyamaḥ ca iti etad rūpam śravaṇa manana phalam dhyā phala bhūtāyāḥ tad dṛṣyeḥ pṛthak eva bhinnam eva atas na brahma dṛṣyiḥ śravaṇa ādinā bhavati iti arthaḥ tathā api na śravaṇa manana vaiyarthyam kutas hi yasmāt apratibandhaḥ brahma dṛṣyi pratibandhaka nivṛttiḥ

original: tanniścayaḥ tanniyamadvārā śravaṇamananayoḥ phalam | ato dhyānasādhyāpi dṛṣyiḥ pratibandhakanivṛttidvārā śravaṇādisādhyā bhavati | tadarthaṃ śravaṇādikamapi kāryamevetyarthaḥ | hi śabdena "ātmā vā are"
analyzed: tad niścayaḥ tad niyama dvārā śravaṇa mananayoḥ phalam atas dhyāna sādhyā api dṛṣyiḥ pratibandhaka nivṛtti dvārā śravaṇa ādi sādhyā bhavati tad artham śravaṇa ādikam api kāryam eva iti arthaḥ hi śabdena ātmā vai are

pradāna adhikaraṇam

original: pradānavat samyak prītipūrvakaṃ gurūpadeśayuktameva śravaṇādikaṃ jñānasādhanaṃ na kevalam | kutaḥ hi yataḥ | taduktam | tasya jñānasya guruprasādādhīnatvaṃ "ācāryavān" iti śrutāvuktamata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pradāna vat samyak prīti pūrvakam guru upadeśa yuktam eva śravaṇa ādikam jñāna sādhanam na kevalam kutas hi yatas tat uktam tasya jñānasya guru prasāda adhīna tvam ācāryavān iti śrutau uktam atas iti arthaḥ
liṅga bhūyaḥ tva adhikaraṇam

original: tat guruprasādapūrvakapradānamātram | balīyaḥ atiśayena balavat | kutaḥ liṃgabhūyastvāt vṛṣabhahaṃsajalavāyasarūpebhyo vāyvagnivaruṇebhyaḥ śrutavidyenāpi satyakāmena vacanāt | liṃgabhūyatsvāt gurupradānādirūpaliṃgabāhulyadarśanāt | tathāpi tadapi śravaṇādikamapi kāryam | kutaḥ "śrotavyaḥ" iti śruterityarthaḥ | hi śabdaḥ śrutisūcakaḥ |
analyzed: tat guru prasāda pūrvaka pradāna mātram balīyaḥ atiśayena balavat kutas liṃga bhūyaḥ tvāt vṛṣabha haṃsa jala vāyasa rūpebhyaḥ vāyu agni varuṇebhyaḥ śrutavidyena api satyakāmena vacanāt liṃga bhūyatsvāt guru pradāna ādi rūpa liṃga bāhulya darśanāt tathā api tat api śravaṇa ādikam api kāryam kutas śrotavyaḥ iti śruteḥ iti arthaḥ hi śabdaḥ śruti sūcakaḥ

original: kriyāmānasavat mānasakriyārūpadhyāne yathā vikalpaḥ tathā pūrvavikalpaḥ pūrvaprāptena guruṇā samasya paścātprāptasya guroḥ | vikalpaḥ grāhyo vā naveti vikalpaḥ syāt | na tu svīkārya eveti vidhiḥ | kutaḥ prakaraṇāt prakṛṣyānugrahamapekṣya guroḥ svīkāyartvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kriyā mānasa vat mānasa kriyā rūpa dhyāne yathā vikalpaḥ tathā pūrva vikalpaḥ pūrva prāptena guruṇā samasya paścāt prāptasya guroḥ vikalpaḥ grāhyaḥ vā na vā iti vikalpaḥ syāt na tu svīkāryaḥ eva iti vidhiḥ kutas prakaraṇāt prakṛṣya anugraham apekṣya guroḥ bhāvaḥ
om atideśāt ca om

original: pūrvaguruṇaiva svasamottamagurusvīkārāyātideśāt | "yathā" iti pauṣyāyaṇaśrutyātidiśyamānatvāt | yuktameva paścāttanasvīkaraṇamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pūrva guruṇā eva sva sama uttama guru svīkārāya atideśāt yathā iti pauṣyāyaṇa śrutyā atidiśyamāna tvāt yuktam eva paścāttana svīkaraṇam iti arthaḥ

original: "nānyaḥ panthāḥ" iti nirdhāraṇāt anyaniṣedhena jñānasyaiva mokṣasādhanatvaniścayāt | vidyaiva mokṣasādhanaṃ na karmādikamityarthaḥ | śruteḥ prābalyadyotakastuśabdaḥ |
analyzed: na anyaḥ panthāḥ iti nirdhāraṇāt anya niṣedhena jñānasya eva mokṣa sādhanatva niścayāt vidyā eva mokṣa sādhanam na karma ādikam iti arthaḥ śruteḥ prābalya dyotakaḥ tuśabdaḥ
om darśanāt ca om

original: na kevalaṃ parokṣamaptirūpavidyayaiva mokṣaḥ | kintu darśanācca brahmasākṣātkārādapi | ato na dhyānavaiyarthyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: na kevalam parokṣa mapti rūpa vidyayā eva mokṣaḥ kintu darśanāt ca brahma sākṣātkārāt api atas na dhyāna vaiyarthyam iti arthaḥ
śruti adhikaraṇam
om śruti ādi balīyaḥ tvāt ca na bādhaḥ om

original: mokṣasya jñānasādhyatve'bādhaḥkarmaṇaiveti smṛtivirodho nāsti kutaḥ | śrutyādibalīyastvāt jñānasya mokṣasādhakatvopapādakatvaṃ "evaṃ viditvā" ityādi śrutiliṃgāderatibalavatvena smṛtigataivaśabdasyāyogavyavacchedārthatvopapatterityarthaḥ | etatsūcanāya caśabdaḥ |
analyzed: mokṣasya jñāna sādhya tve bādhaḥkarmaṇā eva iti smṛti virodhaḥ na asti kutas śruti ādi balīyaḥ tvāt jñānasya mokṣa sādhaka tva upapādaka tvam evam viditvā ityādi śruti liṃga ādeḥ ati balavat tvena smṛti gata eva śabdasya ayoga vyavaccheda artha tva upapatteḥ iti arthaḥ etad sūcanāya caśabdaḥ
anubandha adhikaraṇam
om anubandha ādibhyaḥ om

original: na kevalaṃ śravaṇādinā | nāpi prabalaguruprasādena brahmadarśanaṃ bhavati | kintvanubandhaśabditaharigurubhaktiśamādibhyaścetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: na kevalam śravaṇa ādinā nā api prabala guru prasādena brahma darśanam bhavati kintu anubandha śabdita hari guru bhakti śama ādibhyaḥ ca iti arthaḥ
prajñā antara adhikaraṇam
om prajñā antara pṛthaktva vat dṛṣyiḥ ca tat uktam om

original: prajñāntaraṃ prajñāviśeṣaḥ | dhyānamiti yāvat | tasya pṛthaktvavat anekaprakāratvavat | tadanusāreṇa dṛṣyiśca brahmadṛṣyirapi anekaprakārā na sarveṣāmekavidhā | kiñca taduktam | taddṛṣyeranekavidhatvaṃ "antarddṛṣyayo" iti śrutāvuktañcetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: prajñāntaram prajñā viśeṣaḥ dhyānam iti yāvat tasya pṛthaktva vat aneka prakāra tva vat tad anusāreṇa dṛṣyiḥ ca brahmadṛṣyiḥ api aneka prakārā na sarveṣām ekavidhā kiñca tat uktam tad dṛṣyeḥ anekavidha tvam iti śrutau uktam ca iti arthaḥ
na sāmānya adhikaraṇam

original: oṃ na sāmānyādapyupalabdhemarṛtyuvanna hi lokāpattiḥ oṃ ||

original: mṛtyuvat mṛtyumātrānantaraṃ yathā na muktiḥ | kintu caramamṛtiviśeṣānantarameva | tadvadatrāpi bhagavadrūpāṇāṃ sāmye'pi upalabdheḥ | bhagavaddṛṣyisāmānyāt sādhāraṇarūpāparokṣajñānāt | na sarveṣāṃ muktiḥ | kintu svasvabimbadarśanādeva | na caivaṃ sāmānyadarśanasya

original: vaiphalyam | tasya maharādilokaprāptisādhanatvāt | na caitāvatā tasya mokṣahetutvaṃ | tasya maharādilokaprāptisādhanatvāt | na caitāvatā tasya mokṣahetutvaṃ prāpnoti | hi yataḥ | lokāpattiḥ lokaprāptimātraṃ na muktiḥ | tasmādityarthaḥ | hītyanena sāmānyadarśanādi (nārāyaṇatantre) tyādi pramāṇaprasiddhiśca sucitā |

original: tarhi kathaṃ bhaktiriti vākyena satsvapyanyasādhaneṣu anubandho bhaktiḥ viśiṣyocyata ityata uktam | bhūyastvāditi | tasyāḥ sādhaneṣu | bhūyastvāt prādhānyāt | tadabhiprāyeṇānubandho bhaktirviśiṣyocyata ityarthaḥ |

analyzed: tuśabdaḥ viśeṣe aṃga avabaddhāḥ hareḥ aṃga āśritāḥ devāḥ api tad parivāra tvena devaiḥ upāsyā tad upasaṃhāre tu viśeṣaḥ asti kaḥ devānām prativedam sarva veda gatāsu śākhāsu uktam yat tat sarvam rudra ādiṣu na upasaṃhāryam kintu yogyam eva iti evam rūpe iti arthaḥ

original: bhūmaguṇaḥ sarvairyathāyogyaṃ nānāprakāreṇopāsyaḥ | natvekaprakāreṇa | kutaḥ | śabdādibhedāt | śabdādipramāṇairadhikāribhedāt | bhūmaguṇasya nānāprakāreṇa pratīterityarthaḥ |

original: vikalpaḥ svasvamokṣasādhanānyanṛsiṃhādyupāsanaṃ kāryaṃ na veti dvividhaḥ prakāraḥ syāt | kutaḥ viśiṣyaphalatvāt tathopāsanasya duritanivṛttirūpaphalaviśeṣamapekṣya kartavyatvane tadanusāreṇa vikalpasyaiva yuktatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: vikalpaḥ sva sva mokṣa sādhanāni anṛsiṃha ādi upāsanam kāryam na vā iti dvividhaḥ prakāraḥ syāt kutas viśiṣya phalatvāt tathā upāsanasya durita nivṛtti rūpa phala viśeṣam apekṣya kartavya tvane tad anusāreṇa vikalpasya eva yuktatvāt iti arthaḥ

original: oṃ kāmyāstu yathākāmaṃ samuccīyeranna vā pūrvahetvabhāvāt oṃ ||
analyzed: om kāmyāḥ tu yathākāmam samuccīyeran na vā pūrva hetu abhāvāt om

original: kāmyāstu kāmyasādhanarūpe kāmitasādhanabhagavayadgurāstu | yathākām | svasvaphale kāmānusāreṇa | samuccīyerannavā amumukṣubhirupasaṃhartavyāḥ mumukṣubhistu nopasaṃhatarvyā iti | vā vyavasthitavikalpaḥ syāt | kutaḥ pūrvahetvabhāvāt mumukṣūṇāṃ mokṣecchāpūrvakālīnapūrvasūtroktānyakāmākhyahetvabhāvāt |
analyzed: kāmyāḥ tu kāmya sādhana rūpe kāmita sādhana bhaga vayat gurāḥ tu sva sva phale kāma anusāreṇa samuccīyeran avā amumukṣubhiḥ upasaṃhartavyāḥ mumukṣubhiḥ tu na upasaṃha tarvyāḥ iti vā vyavasthita vikalpaḥ syāt kutas pūrva hetu abhāvāt mumukṣūṇām mokṣa icchā pūrva kālīna pūrva sūtra ukta anya kāma ākhya hetu abhāvāt

original: evaṃ mumubhireveśvaraprītyarthamupasaṃhāryā phalārthaṃ nopasaṃhāryā iti vā vikalpaḥ syādityarthaḥ |

original: aṃgeṣu bhagavadaṃgeṣu | yathā''śrayabhāvaḥ | "cakṣoḥ sūryo'jāyata" ityādau yathā yathā''śrayatvamuktaṃ tathā tairupāsanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: aṃgeṣu bhagavat aṃgeṣu yathā āśraya bhāvaḥ cakṣoḥ sūryaḥ jāyate ityādau yathā yathā āśraya tvam uktam tathā taiḥ upāsanam kartavyam iti arthaḥ

original: guṇānāṃ bhagavadguṇānāṃ | sādhāraṇyasya sarvopāsyatvasya | śruteḥ "sādhāraṇyāt" iti (māṇḍavya) śrutyuktatvācca | devaistathopāsanaṃ kāryamityatharḥ |
analyzed: guṇānām bhagavat guṇānām sādhāraṇyasya sarva upāsya tvasya śruteḥ sādhāraṇyāt iti māṇḍavya śruti ukta tvāt ca devaiḥ tathā upāsanam kāryam iti atharḥ

original: aṃgadevatopāsanaṃ devānyaiḥ na kāryam | kintu devaireveti vā vyavasthitavikalpaḥ syāt | kutaḥ atatsahabhāvaśruteḥ tatsahaśruterabhāvāt | sarvakhāgataguṇopāsanena sahāṃgadevatopāsanasya śravaṇādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: aṃga devatā upāsanam deva anyaiḥ na kāryam kintu devaiḥ eva iti vā vyavasthita vikalpaḥ syāt kutas atatsahabhāva śruteḥ tad saha śruteḥ abhāvāt sarva khā gata guṇa upāsanena saha aṃga devatā upāsanasya śravaṇāt iti arthaḥ
om darśanāt ca om

analyzed: ādyaḥ caḥ nañaḥ samākarṣaṇa arthaḥ śruti samuccayaḥ dvitīyaḥ tathā ca lakṣmīḥ na līyate kutas yatas tasyāḥ an upeṣya paramātmānam an upāsya eva amṛta tvam nitya mukta tvam tat kutas asṛthi upakramāt kadāpi saṃsāra upakrama abhāvāt saḥ api kutas yatas samanā deśataḥ kālataḥ samaḥ nā parama puruṣaḥ yasyāḥ sā samanā tasmāt iti arthaḥ

original: prakṛterapi sūkṣmaṃ brahma pramāṇataḥ jñānānandādiguraparimāṇataścādhikam | kutaḥ tathopalabdheḥ "sarvata" iti (taraśru) tathā śruteḥ | ato'pi prakṛteḥ na brahma sāmyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: prakṛteḥ api sūkṣmam brahma pramāṇataḥ jñāna ānanda ādi guru parimāṇataḥ ca adhikam kutas tathā upalabdheḥ sarvatas iti tathā śruteḥ atas api prakṛteḥ na brahma sāmyam iti arthaḥ

om asya eva ca upapatteḥ ūṣmā om

original: ūṣmāvatvānūṣmāvatvapratipādikā "dvidhā hīdam" iti (sauparṇa) śrutirapyasyaiva kiñcitsāmyarūpārthasyaivopapatteḥ ghaṭanāyopapādikā bhavatītyatharḥ |

om pratiṣedhāt iti ced na śārīrāt om

original: pratiṣedhāt īśvarasyānyasāmyapratiṣedhāt | prakṛteḥ deśakālavyāptyādināpi paramātmasāmyaṃ neti cenna | kutaḥ yataḥ śārīrāt jīvenaiveś­varasya sāmyaṃ pratiṣidhyate na prakṛtitaḥ | ata ityatharḥ |

original: hi yasmāt | ekeṣāṃ śākhāsu prakṛteḥ atheti (mādhyandina) samā'samatvavādaḥ spaṣyo'sti tasmādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: hi yasmāt ekeṣām śākhāsu prakṛteḥ atha iti mādhyandina sama asama tva vādaḥ spaṣyaḥ usti tasmāt iti arthaḥ
om smaryate ca om

original: bhagavadicchātadbhaktecchānām | avibhāgo viṣayaikyam | na tu virodhaḥ | kutaḥ vacanāt "ete devāḥ" iti (gaupavana) śruterityarthaḥ |

original: oṃ tadoko'grajvalanaṃ tatprakāśitadvāro vidyāsāmarthyāttaccheṣagatyanusmṛtiyogācca hārdānugṛhītaḥ śatādhikayā oṃ ||

original: tasminnutkrāntikāle | tadoko'grajvalanaṃ tasya paramātmanaḥ okasaḥ āśrayabhūtasya hṛdayasyāgre jvalanaṃ bhavati | atha tatprakāśitadvāraḥ tena prakāśena vidyotitamārgaḥ san | dehājjīva utkrāmati | nanu kathametadyujyate | vidyāsāmarthyāt jñānasāmarthyāt | taccheṣagatyanusmṛtiyogācca vidyāṅgaprāpyasmaraṇasāhityācca |
analyzed: tasmin utkrānti kāle tat oka ugra jvalanam tasya paramātmanaḥ okasaḥ āśraya bhūtasya hṛdayasya agre jvalanam bhavati atha tad prakāśita dvāraḥ tena prakāśena vidyotita mārgaḥ san dehāt jīvaḥ utkrāmati nanu katham etat yujyate vidyā sāmarthyāt jñāna sāmarthyāt tad śeṣa gati anusmṛti yogāt ca vidyā aṅga prāpya smaraṇa sāhityāt ca

analyzed: kiñca hārda anugṛhītaḥ hṛdaya stha bhagavat anugṛhītaḥ san yāti kayā śata adhikayā suṣumnā nāḍyā iti arthaḥ
om raśmi anusārī om
raśmi anusārī antar sthita āditya prakāśa anusārī san jīvaḥ niṣkāmati iti arthaḥ

original: oṃ niśi neti cenna sambandhāt oṃ ||

original: yāvaddehabhāvitvāt raśmisambandhasya yāvaccharīrabhāvitvāt | rātrāvapi jñāninaḥ utkramaṇaṃ yuktam | kutaḥ darśayati co yataḥ | darśayati "saṃsṛṣyā" iti (mādhyandināyana) śrutiḥ tathā pratipādayati ata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yāvat deha bhāvi tvāt raśmi sambandhasya yāvat śarīra bhāvi tvāt rātrau api jñāninaḥ utkramaṇam yuktam kutas darśayati caḥ yatas darśayati saṃsṛṣyā iti mādhyandināyana śrutiḥ tathā pratipādayati atas iti arthaḥ

original: saptamyarthe pañcamī | ubhayavyāmohāt pūrvoktavāyurātivāhiko mukhyo vā uttaroktavāyurātivāhiko mukhyo veti sandehe | tatsiddheḥ tena sivaspatitvaviśeṣaṇena tasya uttaroktasya vāyormukhyatvasiddhaḥ nānirṇaya ityarthaḥ |

original: jñānī paraṃ brahmaiva gacchati | kutaḥ tena śravaṇādibhiḥ parabrahmaṇa eva dṛṣyatvādityarthaḥ |

original: enāṃ vyavasthāmanaṅgīkṛtya sarveṣāṃ ekaikaprāptyaṅgīkāre kāryabrahmaparabrahmaprāptyaṅgīkāre kāryabrahmaparabrahmaprāptipakṣadvayoktadoṣaprāpteḥ | nanu yatprāptumabhivāñchiti tatprāpnotīti (pādma) vacanāttattadicchāmātreṇa tattatprāptisambhavānnoktavyavasthāṅgīkāryetyata āha | tatkratuśceti |
